generated_output.title: Weekend Excursion: Making Suggestions for a Class Trip
generated_output.learning_objective: Students can make, accept, and counter-propose travel suggestions using 'Shall we...?' and 'Why don't we...?' in a collaborative paired decision task.
generated_output.student_instructions: In pairs, look at the travel options for a day trip. Suggest activities to your partner using 'Shall we...?' and 'Why don't we...?'. Agree on one destination and departure time.
generated_output.teacher_instructions: Model the suggestion frames on the board. Monitor pairs for bare infinitive use. Select 3 pairs to present their final itinerary.

target_structures: Shall we + base verb (e.g., Shall we take the train?)
Why don't we + base verb (e.g., Why don't we visit the zoo?)
Let's + base verb (e.g., Let's meet at 9:00 AM)
sentence_frames: That sounds like a great idea!
I'm not so sure. Why don't we... instead?

activity_steps.teacher_action: Display photos of 3 travel destinations. Model: 'Why don't we visit the museum?'. Elicit choral response.
activity_steps.student_action: Listen and repeat the target phrase with rising-falling intonation.

activity_steps.teacher_action: Hand out paired trip cards. Monitor pair negotiation and prompt turn-taking.
activity_steps.student_action: Student A suggests a destination; Student B reacts and counter-proposes until an agreement is reached.

activity_steps.teacher_action: Ask 3 pairs to state their decision: 'We decided to go to... because...'. Provide praise and target form feedback.
activity_steps.student_action: Report pair decision to the whole class in two connected sentences.

assessment.evidence: Paired oral decision demonstrating at least 2 suggestion formulas and 1 polite reaction.
criteria: Uses bare infinitive after Shall we and Why don't we
Maintains turn-taking without switching to Spanish
Includes at least 3 travel vocabulary terms
success_criteria: Uses bare infinitive after Shall we and Why don't we
